command_executed: ./websearch --no-cache -m reason "Redis Cluster returns MOVED and ASK redirections continuously causing latency spikes in a Go application using go-redis when cluster is rebalancing slots after adding a new node"

evaluation.summary: 3.3/5.0 - Correct root cause analysis of MOVED/ASK redirections but solutions are too vague to act on
evaluation.key_strengths: Accurately distinguishes MOVED vs ASK semantics and correctly identifies stale slot-to-node cache as the primary source of latency spikes during resharding.
evaluation.key_weaknesses: Solutions section lacks any concrete go-redis code examples or specific ClusterOptions fields (e.g., MaxRedirects, RouteByLatency, topology refresh interval settings), making it difficult to act on the advice.
